inputs.text: A single boss character render for a dark fantasy action RPG: Goruk, the Goblin Warboss, the first dungeon level's overlord, seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, full body, centered on a plain dark obsidian #171719 background with a soft rim light so the asset can be cut out cleanly. A huge goblinoid warlord, twice the size of an armored hero, with massive shoulders, thick hide, heavy hands and a hulking imposing boss silhouette that must stay readable against dungeon floor. War-painted deep red skin (blood burgundy #642A32 shading with warmer #b03a3a highlights), snarling flat goblin face with small bright eyes, heavy underbite. He wears heavy lamellar plates banded with antique gold #A98A50 edge trim, mismatched pauldrons, a broken spiked iron crown wedged on his head as a war trophy, muted brown #594536 hide breeches and a trophy belt of stolen signet rings and dog tags. Both hands drag a notched black-iron war cleaver whose edge glows a faint infernal orange #D85C27. Dark Gothic Fantasy, realistic stylization, painterly detail, physically believable materials: aged iron, leather, hide, tarnished gold. Bosses must be visually impressive without sacrificing readability, so keep the silhouette strong, uncluttered and distinct from ordinary goblins. No text, no watermark.
